## Contraventions Regulations {#contraventions-regulations .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/96-313
:::

[CONTRAVENTIONS ACT](/eng/acts/C-38.7)

Registration 1996-06-20

Contraventions Regulations

P.C. 1996-915 1996-06-20
::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
His Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the recommendation of
the Minister of Justice, pursuant to section 8[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#footnotea_e){#footnotea_e-ID0EGCAA} of the
[Contraventions Act](/eng/acts/C-38.7)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^b^](#footnoteb_e){#footnoteb_e-ID0EDCAA}, hereby makes
the annexed [Contraventions Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-96-313),
effective August 1, 1996.

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#footnotea_e-ID0EGCAA){#footnotea_e}S.C. 1996, c.
  7, s. 4
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^b^](#footnoteb_e-ID0EDCAA){#footnoteb_e}S.C. 1992, c.
  47
  :::
:::

## [Designation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-981788 .Part}

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** An offence under a
provision of an enactment set out in column I of the Schedules is
designated as a contravention for the purposes of the [Contraventions
Act](/eng/acts/C-38.7).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-161, s. 1
- SOR/97-208, s. 1
:::

## [Short-Form Description]{.HTitleText1} {#h-981792 .Part}

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** The short-form description
of an offence under a provision set out in column I of the Schedules is
the description set out in column II.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-161, s. 1
- SOR/97-208, s. 1
- [SOR/2022-221, s. 1(E)](#1378254-1378343){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1378254-1378343.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-2-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 2"){.PITLink}
:::

## [Fine]{.HTitleText1} {#h-981796 .Part}

- **[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of proceedings commenced by means of a ticket in respect of a
  contravention for which the short-form description is set out in
  column II of the Schedules, the amount of the fine is the applicable
  amount set out in column III.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the contravention of a provision set out in column
  I of the Schedules is related to a quota or a limit and both a base
  amount of the fine and an additional amount are set out in column III,
  the first item that exceeds the quota or limit is not subject to the
  additional amount.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-208, s. 1
- [SOR/2022-221, s. 2(E)](#1378256-1378345){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1378256-1378345.html"
  role="button"}
- [SOR/2024-243, s. 1](#1496556-1497818){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1496556-1497818.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-3-20221024.html "Link to previous version of section 3"){.PITLink}
:::

## [Young Persons]{.HTitleText1} {#h-1244463 .Part}

**[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** In the case of a
contravention committed by a young person, the amount of a fine that may
be imposed in respect of that contravention is deemed to be the lesser
of \$100 and the applicable amount set out in column III to the
Schedules.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2020-86, s. 1](#1243272-1244466){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1243272-1244466.html"
  role="button"}
- [SOR/2022-221, s. 3(E)](#1378258-1378347){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1378258-1378347.html"
  role="button"}
:::
